title: Measurements
summary: Assign dense observed periods with measurement count, mean, last value and a separately named carry-forward value at period start. Carry-forward uses the last nonmissing value at or before that start within lookback and expiry. It does not replace period mean/last, use future values, or assert that a value remains constant throughout the period. Event-free periods retain count zero and numeric NA; an unavailable source gives NA.

required_tables.conditional: Tables, value/unit/time roles and vocabulary required by the supplied index and other event bindings.

required_roles.index: person, event key, start; interval end according to index policy
required_roles.measure: numeric value_as_number and declared scale/unit policy

limitations: See documentation for fixed policies, windows, missingness, coverage, tie order, output schema and analysis limitations.
